claims.text: Many service businesses respond to slowing bookings by increasing ad spend instead of fixing follow-up
Ad spend without a solid follow-up system leaks leads that more traffic can't fix
Checking response time and follow-up touch count on the last 20 leads reveals whether the bottleneck is traffic or follow-up

claims.text: The platform includes referral tracking as part of its CRM and automation feature set.
A job-complete trigger can fire a timed referral text, with a tracked link crediting the original customer when their friend books.
Most service businesses still ask for referrals informally or by memory rather than on a written schedule.
Google Business Profiles now let businesses manage a direct appointment-booking link instead of only a generic contact form
The Black Arrow platform includes a booking page available with a 14-day free trial, no card required
